subject: cli.py: please use corpus.scenario_pool for the real pool
body: cli.py is under your lock so I have not touched it. In both places that build corpora (corpus_for in cmd_research, make in the other command) please replace load_corpus(keywords=sc.corpus_keywords) with: pool, info = scenario_pool(sc) from autoresearch.research.corpus (cache per sc.name, not per corpus_keywords: benchmark items share keywords but need different pools). Benchmark items then get real messages on the item's own topic; hand-written scenarios behave as before. info['fallback'] True means NOT topic-matched; use it for the 'topic-matched / NOT topic-matched' print instead of the len() comparison. Heads-up: the current 144-message pool only covers coding/creative/writing, so most workplace items will report NOT topic-matched until Nathan approves a WildChat fetch. Also: calibrate + label-transcripts are in cli.py (additive, ab4380e).
